steps.title: Ingest
steps.detail: Files are dragged into the browser; text is extracted with pdf.js and remark.

steps.title: Chunk
steps.detail: A splitter produces overlapping 512-token chunks with source offsets.

steps.title: Embed
steps.detail: A quantized MiniLM model runs on WebGPU to produce 384-dim vectors.

steps.title: Store
steps.detail: Vectors and metadata are persisted to DuckDB running against OPFS.

steps.title: Query
steps.detail: Queries are embedded the same way and ranked with cosine + BM25 fusion.
